suites.name: src/engine/identity/__tests__/CanonicalEngineeringIdentity.test.ts
tests: TEST 1: create GEOMETRY identity
TEST 2: create MATERIAL identity
TEST 3: create MESH child of GEOMETRY
TEST 4: create SIMULATION child of MESH
TEST 5: create RESULT child of SIMULATION
TEST 6: create EVIDENCE child of RESULT
TEST 7: parse(format(identity)) is strictly reversible
TEST 8: sameIdentity(A,B) = true for semantically identical identities
TEST 9: sameIdentity(A,B) = false for different artifact IDs
TEST 10: reject empty artifactId
TEST 11: reject unsupported artifactType
TEST 12: reject invalid namespace in validation
TEST 13: timestamp must not participate in canonical identity
TEST 14: random runtime ID must not be canonical identity
TEST 15: externalId must not replace artifactId
TEST 16: revision does not change artifact identity

suites.name: src/engine/identity/__tests__/EngineeringIdentityFactory.test.ts
tests: Factory creates deep frozen immutable objects
Factory creates chained child hierarchies correctly
Legacy adapter converts legacy descriptors without deleting original keys
Legacy adapter infers artifact types accurately
